vote.question: FUTARCHY CONDITIONAL RESOLUTION [US-FL U.S. Senate]: Ashley Moody (R) has accumulated $14,524,032 in career FEC-reported receipts (anchored this cycle by Elon Musk ($168,000,000) and $365,507,000 from top-5 patrons)—out-raising general opponent Angela Nixon ($11,319,380) by 1.28x—exhibiting the "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate" profile. Will independent constituent & oracle review confirm that this private-interest capital concentration compromises public representation in US-FL, thereby executing the FL Corrective Restitution Pool toward affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Private campaign financing treats US-FL representation as an investable asset class. When Ashley Moody's campaign apparatus absorbs $14,524,032 (anchored this cycle by Elon Musk ($168,000,000) and $365,507,000 from top-5 patrons), policy incentives skew toward housing financialization, consumer debt deregulation, and tax-code arbitrage. This futarchy market converts spectator outrage into direct fiscal counter-leverage.
